title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Offset Share, Recovery Rank and Application Order
content:
The Recovery Unit applies these figures to Benefit Overpayment Accounts according to the classification of each account.

| Classification | Share of each weekly payable benefit amount applied by offset | Recovery rank (1 receives first) | Order of application among components | Offsets other programs (EB, TRA, UCFE, UCX) | Offsets another state's payments under the interstate reciprocal offset arrangement | Offsets continue while a repayment plan is current |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 0.50 (50 percent) | 6 | Principal only | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 0.50 (50 percent) | 5 | Principal only | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 0.50 (50 percent) | 4 | Principal only | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 0.50 (50 percent) | 3 | Principal only | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 1.00 (100 percent) | 2 | Principal, then penalty, then interest | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 1.00 (100 percent) | 1 | Principal, then penalty, then interest | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Terms used in the table

- **Offset share**: the part of each weekly payable benefit amount that is applied to the balance by offset.
- **Recovery rank**: the order in which a claimant's open overpayments receive recoveries that are not designated to one of them; rank 1 receives first.
- **Order of application**: the order in which one recovery is applied among the components of one overpayment.

## Questions answered from the table

**Which of a claimant's overpayments receives an undesignated recovery first when one is Fraud Overpayment — First Offense and one is Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error?** The Fraud Overpayment — First Offense account, rank 2, ahead of rank 6.

**How much of a hypothetical weekly payable amount of USD 400.00 does the offset share of a Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error account represent?** 50 percent of it, USD 200.00.
